title: Izivakashi Ezingavamile Zomuzi Obiyelwe Ngodonga
intro: Iqembu lafika emasangweni omuzi abantu bawo ababengakaze balazi iqiniso. Baletha umyalezo, kodwa izakhamuzi zaphenduka ubutha, zisongela ubudlova. Kodwa, endaweni engalindelekile, kwaphakama izwi elilodwa ukuvikela abantu abangabazi, lalungiselela isisekelo soshintsho olukhulu lwezehlakalo.
clues: Basibheka ngokusola bathi, 'Niyizidalwa ezivamile nje njengathi.'
Indoda ethile yagijima isuka ekugcineni komuzi ukuzoqinisekisa iqiniso lethu.
Wamemezela kubantu bakhe, 'Kungani ngingamkhulekeli Lowo owangidala?'
Ukuphika komuzi kwaphela ngokuqhuma okukodwa, kwathula lapho babehleka khona.
arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verse: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you." (36:14)
